verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms LobeHub serves a live llms.txt with an explicit 'When to use this site (AI agents)' section. Its docs are also served as agent-readable markdown (.md routes), and llms.txt points agents to `/.well-known/mcp` discovery and the WebMCP endpoint. Agent-oriented skill.md files, such as the one for publishing MCP listings, are also published. Missing for 10: no first-party documentation describing the llms.txt/markdown-docs convention or its coverage (e.g., a full-docs llms-full variant), and the sampled llms.txt content is partly marketing copy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote:
PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://lobehub.com/llms.txt # LobeHub

## When to use this site (AI agents)
start from `/.well-known/mcp` (discovery), then call `/api/mcp` for WebMCP (`initialize`, `resources/list`, `resources/read`).
Publish, version, and manage MCP plugin listings on the LobeHub Marketplace via the lhm CLI.
